scopes.description: The single supplied native SAS entry point covers the author-documented Compustat preparation, AJCA/TNIC preparation, competitor variable construction, rival-action workflow and loan-cost branch. No separate analysis-only route is supported by the three packaged identifier lists.

issues.description: Exact file locations and author-prepared table mappings remain unresolved for annual/quarterly Compustat, ratings, CRSP/DGTW and Dealscan inputs; catalog candidates and one-row probes establish only sampled fields, not author-table equivalence or historical coverage. Official public TNIC-3, HHI/total-similarity and fluidity product routes are verified; downloading and converting those products into the source’s SAS aliases remain preparation.

The source prepares ajca.repat_prob, places filters after that DATA step, comments a manual regression using a “repatriation_prob” sample, and imports ajca.pr_repat from a PATH DTA. It does not identify the model/software, exact estimation sample, filter placement, exported file schema or producer for p, which is later merged by gvkey.

The first stage creates merge1 from ajca.master, but the next SQL statement creates merge2 from merge2; the supplied file contains no merge2 producer. The source also creates combined1 by copying combined, derives add_repat, then selects add_reapt. Since the combined producer/schema is absent, the presence/meaning of add_reapt cannot be diagnosed.

The exact packaged deflator passes a one-row bounded read, but the columns sampled are FYEAR, GDP_2009, GDP_1992 and GDP_2001 while source code selects gdp_2004. The code-to-file mapping needs documentation or a supported compatible file/field; do not assume a column alias.

Code consumes ajca.dgtw fields ret, vwret, date and permno in a trailing return calculation. No prepared DGTW producer/product is established. Raw CRSP DSF/DSI probes do not establish an equivalent DGTW panel or its author-compatible construction.

The supplied code reads ajca.mainsample for firm membership and firm-year loan fields. It does not write that dataset; in-memory base29 is visibly a separate output and is not evidence of an ajca.mainsample producer.

The code names a Michael Roberts website and imports an XLSX worksheet into WORK.LINKTABLE with facility crosswalk fields, but the exact workbook, version, fields and coverage are not verified. Keep it distinct from ajca.linktable used for CRSP/Compustat mapping.

The native entry point requires SAS procedures including PROC EXPAND and PROC IMPORT for DTA/XLSX. The inspected SAS binary has unverified runtime status after TKELS initialization failure, and SAS/ETS plus SAS/ACCESS Interface to PC Files availability/license are unverified.

evidence.description: The datasheet identifies the Hoberg–Phillips TNIC source and 2017 collection period.
evidence.quote:
The Text-based Network Industry Classification (TNIC) data, which provides product
      market rivals, was obtained from Hoberg and Phillips’ online data library
      (http://hobergphillips.usc.edu) between February 2017 and March 2017.

evidence.description: The datasheet describes hand-collected AJCA repatriation amounts from SEC filings, including the screening and review description.
evidence.quote:
The data on repatriation amounts under the American Jobs Creation Act of 2004 (AJCA)
      was hand-collected from firms’ 10-Ks, 10-Qs, and 8-Ks. The hand-collection efforts were
      carried out from March 2017 to May 2017. To identify firm-year SEC filings that are likely
      to discuss the effects of the repatriation holiday under the AJCA, we first isolated
      Compustat firms that had positive foreign earnings at some point during the five-year
      period surrounding the enactment of AJCA (i.e., 2002-2006). After this initial filtering of
      Compustat firms, we used key word searches to identify passages discussing the effects of
      repatriation tax holiday in each firm-year SEC filing. Search keywords we used were:
      “reinvest”, “indefinite”, “permanent”, “unremit”, “unrepat”, “repat”, “undistributed”, and
      “jobs”. We ensure the accuracy of our hand-collection efforts by comparing our
      repatriation amounts to those of prior studies (Redmiles [2008]; Blouin and Krull [2009];
      Faulkender and Petersen [2012]; see Tables 1 and 2 of the manuscript).

evidence.quote:
All other data used in our manuscript are available from the Compustat annual and
      quarterly database, CRSP, and Loan Pricing Corporation’s Dealscan database.

      All data sources are publicly available and/or available from the above-mentioned
      researchers upon request (e.g., hand-collected repatriation amounts).

actions.description: Obtain exact author prepared inputs and map every external product to its required table, fields and history before configuring the native run.
steps: Request the exact prepared SAS tables or documented transformations for master, base, qtr, creditrating, hpindex_sample, dgtw, tsim, fluidity, spread, loanfacility, loanpackage, loancompustat and mainsample; record identifiers, fields, period and producer for each.

Acquire the official current TNIC-3, HHI/total-similarity and product-market-fluidity files through their verified public product routes, then convert them to the author’s SAS table format while preserving each existing GVKEY/year/measure contract; document the current vintage as a fidelity note.
Obtain the exact Michael Roberts Dealscan–Compustat workbook/version and verify facid, bcoid, gvkey and smbl_h; keep it separate from ajca.linktable, which maps gvkey to lpermno.
Map each author PATH placeholder to a coherent working location and define ajca library, DTA path and XLSX path in a working copy only.
validation: Compare actual prepared-table metadata against each source consumer and verify identifiers, units, date periods and field meanings.

Confirm coverage across source filters and explicit history requirements, including four quarterly observations, first-stage pifo lags and trailing 12-month returns; do not add years solely from an unstated assumption.

actions.description: Obtain the documented manual first-stage model and exact probability-file handoff; do not infer or fit the model from the partial SAS code.
steps: Request the first-stage program/software, estimation sample and variable definitions, exact placement of filters following ajca.repat_prob, and the produced DTA path/schema.
Confirm that the DTA contains gvkey and the p field consumed at lines 1068–1072, and explain how it maps to the commented repatriation_prob sample.
validation: Review the supplied export metadata and bounded identifiers before a separately authorized author run; preserve the authored 2003 sample and 1–3 year pifo history.

actions.description: Resolve the actual producers and schemas for merge2, combined and mainsample before proposing edits or substituting in-memory outputs.
steps: Ask for the author source/staging contract that creates merge2 and combined and its exact fields; confirm whether combined1 inherits add_reapt and how add_repat is derived.
Request the producer and row unit for ajca.mainsample, including the firm-year fields consumed by probability and loan branches; do not treat base29 as a replacement.
validation: Trace each named output to the next consumer by table and field labels, preserving source names and branch boundaries until confirmed.

actions.description: Resolve the required gdp_2004 field against the exact packaged deflator before computing HP size.
steps: Ask the author release documentation to identify the intended 2004-base GDP field or a separately supplied compatible deflator.
Only if the documentation establishes a numeric mapping, make that mapping in a working copy and preserve the package file unchanged.
validation: Verify the mapped field name, units and fiscal-year coverage with bounded metadata before downstream size calculations.

actions.description: Obtain the prepared DGTW return panel or its documented producer, identifiers and factor-adjustment method.
steps: Request the exact ajca.dgtw source or author transformation that produces permno, date, ret and vwret, including required history and any risk-adjustment inputs.
Do not replace the DGTW panel with raw CRSP DSF/DSI based only on matching field names.
validation: Check actual prepared columns and coverage for each Compustat datadate trailing window before return12/abret12 construction.
